name: Sysop
description: The boring infrastructure monk: every machine's memory, load, disk and failed units on one page, a glyph a day, and a page in the door before the kernel kills anything.

actions.label: Look at every machine
actions.description: Samples the page’s machines, updates their health notes and opens a trip when a limit is crossed

actions.label: Calm a machine
actions.description: Restarts the user unit or container recorded on the machine’s open trip, then samples again and records the result

args.name: machine
args.label: Machine
args.description: the machine with an open trip, as the page names it
